name: Mikagari Mashiro
source:
A young genius witch under the tutelage of Suzuko. But her sense of direction is left to be desired. 

[spoiler]She is actually Kazuki, Shizuki and Mizuki's biological mother, as well as Mion's older sister, Ichijou Misora (一条 美空). She was bound to the guardian deity​ system "Haru", lost her memory and made younger through Haru's power over time.[/spoiler]
